signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: - For you Unlimited resumes cover letters
20 AI credits — enough to generate 2–3 tailored resumes and matching cover letters, so you can test the AI's writing quality and the full workflow before paying anything.
The 20 AI credits cover the things that actually cost compute — AI rewriting your bullets, tailoring your resume to a job description, drafting cover letters from scratch.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 4.25/5 vs 4.31/5 all-time (-0.06). 13% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 2.5 years old. Sold on AppSumo 3 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $49 vs a stated $156 regular price (69% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time.

trials.claim: Unlimited resumes and cover letters for all 3 users
trials.claimQuote: For all 3 users Unlimited resumes cover letters
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports being told to move to paid plans, which directly limits the promised unlimited resumes and cover letters for deal users; the 20-credit test offer alone would not prove this.

exhibits.quote: they started sending emails that you will need to move to the paid plans
exhibits.argument: The quote shows unlimited creation was later restricted by requiring a move to paid plans.

exhibits.quote: 20 AI credits — enough to generate 2–3 tailored resumes and matching cover letters, so you can test
exhibits.argument: The quote shows resume and cover letter generation is credit-limited to 2-3, not unlimited.

trials.claim: All future Monthly Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates
trials.reasoning: The generic rights to modify terms or terminate for breach do not specifically say future Monthly Plan updates are excluded, and no exhibit directly confirms the update promise.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time.
exhibits.argument: The quote lets the vendor change terms at any time, undermining guaranteed future updates.

exhibits.quote: We may terminate or suspend your access to the Website at any time, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.
exhibits.argument: The quote allows termination of access at any time for any reason, voiding future update promises.

trials.claim: Builds ATS-friendly resumes and cover letters, tracks job applications, and optimizes LinkedIn profile
trials.claimQuote: ResumeUp.AI helps you build ATS-friendly resumes and cover letters, track job applications, and optimize your LinkedIn profile.
trials.reasoning: Reviews report LinkedIn-related bugs with many features not working as described and identical cover letters for different jobs, materially undercutting the claimed working bundle.

exhibits.quote: It’s filled with bugs, particularly when used with LinkedIn, and many of the features simply don’t work as described.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports LinkedIn and other features do not work as described.

exhibits.quote: Resumeup gave her the same verbatim cover letter.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows cover letters are not tailored but identical across different jobs.

exhibits.quote: ResumeUp.AI bundles six job search tools in one workspace: resume builder, ATS checker, cover letter generator, LinkedIn optimizer
exhibits.argument: Vendor states one workspace includes resume builder, cover letter generator, LinkedIn optimizer and tracker, matching the claimed bundle.

exhibits.quote: Software customizes your Resume and Cover letter for each job application and optimises to pass the ATS initial stage.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool customizes resumes and cover letters to pass ATS screening.

trials.claim: Creates tailored resumes that pass ATS screening and catch recruiters' attention
trials.claimQuote: Create perfectly tailored resumes that pass ATS screening and catch recruiters' attention.
trials.reasoning: Reviews call the ATS Score Checker claims deceptive and report invented information added to resumes, directly conflicting with tailored resumes that pass ATS screening.

exhibits.quote: The claims related to the ATS Score Checker feature are deceptive and misleading.
exhibits.argument: The quote directly calls the ATS claims deceptive and misleading.

exhibits.quote: it was inventing information and adding it to my resume
exhibits.argument: The quote shows tailoring invents false information rather than catching recruiter attention truthfully.

exhibits.quote: Paste any job description and our AI instantly rewrites your resume with targeted keywords, and ATS-friendly templates.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states AI rewrites resumes with targeted keywords and ATS-friendly templates for each job description.

exhibits.quote: Excellent tool - great way to easily create a customized resume based upon a job description and have it optimized
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms easy creation of customized job-description-based resumes that are optimized.

trials.claim: Evaluates resume against 20+ ATS and recruiter standards with feedback in one place
trials.claimQuote: ResumeUp.AI can evaluate your resume against 20+ ATS and recruiter standards, giving you insightful feedback in one place.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states the checker scans against 28 checks covering ATS compatibility and recruiter readability, exceeding 20+ standards; testing against five named ATS platforms does not limit the number of checks.

exhibits.quote: ResumeUp.AI is tested against five major ATS platforms: Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, and Oracle Taleo.
exhibits.argument: The quote limits testing to five named ATS platforms, not 20+ ATS standards.

exhibits.quote: It scans against 28 checks, grammar, keyword matching, ATS compatibility and recruiter readability.
exhibits.argument: The quote describes 28 general checks, not evaluation against 20+ ATS and recruiter standards.

exhibits.quote: It scans against 28 checks, grammar, keyword matching, ATS compatibility and recruiter readability.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states scanning against 28 checks covering ATS compatibility and recruiter readability, exceeding 20 standards.

exhibits.quote: Run your resume through ATS Resume Checker for a real-time score.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the checker provides a real-time score for the resume evaluation.
